destination.name: Oregon circuit court where the conviction was entered
destination.detail: A motion filed with the circuit court, served on the prosecuting attorney who prosecuted the offence, with a full set of fingerprints forwarded to the Department of State Police. Under ORS 137.225(2)(b) the prosecuting attorney provides a copy of the motion and notice of the hearing date to the victim, if any, at the victim's last-known address, and under ORS 137.225(3)(a) the court allows the victim to make a statement at any hearing. The clerk forwards a certified copy of the order to the agencies the court directs, and a certified copy must go to the Department of Corrections when the order concerns a conviction.
destination.venue: The circuit court where the conviction was entered. A person with convictions in several counties files separately in each.

mustBringOrRequest.name: Oregon State Police LEDS criminal history
mustBringOrRequest.obtainedFrom: Oregon State Police
mustBringOrRequest.howToObtain: Use the Oregon State Police set-aside criminal history request and instructions retained in Edition 1.2, or the Oregon Judicial Department request for a set-aside criminal record check. It fixes the offence class, the disposition and the sentence-completion dates, and it is obtained before anything is drafted.

mustBringOrRequest.name: Proof that the sentence was fully complied with and performed
mustBringOrRequest.obtainedFrom: The circuit court, probation or parole, and whoever collected restitution, fines and fees
mustBringOrRequest.howToObtain: Gather the probation or post-prison supervision discharge, the release from custody, and receipts or a zero-balance statement for restitution, fines and fees. ORS 137.225(1)(a) makes full compliance the threshold and treats a person still under supervision as not having complied.

mustBringOrRequest.name: A full set of fingerprints
mustBringOrRequest.obtainedFrom: A law enforcement agency or an authorised fingerprinting service
mustBringOrRequest.howToObtain: Have a full set of fingerprints taken on a fingerprint card, or in any other manner the Department of State Police specifies, and forward them to the department with its record-check fee. ORS 137.225(2)(c) and (2)(d).

mustBringOrRequest.name: FBI Identity History Summary
mustBringOrRequest.obtainedFrom: Federal Bureau of Investigation
mustBringOrRequest.howToObtain: Request an Identity History Summary from the FBI. ORS 137.225 cannot reach federal or other states' records, and the participant should know what will remain.
